lore_anchors.definition: A high-ranking fire-element cultivation art from the Chaotic Star Sea. Its Solarblaze True Flame is powerful, but it is vulnerable to suppression by the Lava Path's restrictions.
A terrifying Nascent Soul cultivator leading Extreme Yin Island. In this chapter, he demonstrates his power by casually strolling through the deadly Crystal Path without a care.
An animate undead mist that drains life and traps souls. It is the first major trial preceding the Lava Path in the Void Heaven Palace.
The opposite, ice-element counterpart to the Lava Path in the Void Heaven Palace, filled with crystalline monsters.
A hedonistic Nascent Soul demonic overlord of the Chaotic Star Sea. His Cold-Ice Pearl was a powerful gift that previously saved Han Li.
The floating jade palace that serves as this arc's central dungeon. A high-risk, high-reward zone for cultivators seeking legendary treasures.
